claims.content: To allow a System Administrator to assign a security level and password to each defined staff member and assign user security levels at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function.

goal.raw_text: To allow a System Administrator to assign a security level and password to each defined staff member and assign user security levels at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function.

claims.content: System Administrator
The GUI provides a Configuration option that is accessible to the System Administrator.
The System Administrator is an RLCS Software user with System Administrative privileges authorized to create and modify system configuration data, including staff.
The staff members to be assigned a security level and password are defined.
The System Administrator accesses the Configuration option to assign a security level and password to a defined staff member.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator accesses the Configuration option to assign a security level and password to a defined staff member.

claims.content: The System Administrator creates and modifies system configuration data, including staff.
The configuration option allows a security level and password to be assigned to each defined staff member.
User security levels are assigned at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function.
When the System Administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI analyzes the data before storing it in the database.
The GUI notifies the System Administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
At main flow step 2, the configuration option also allows user accounts to be changed remotely in the field units.
If the GUI identifies conflicting or redundant entries while analyzing the data before storing it in the database, it notifies the System Administrator.

Exception 1 (conflicting or redundant entries): When the system administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI analyzes the data before storing in the database and notifies the system administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries; exit: the system administrator is notified of the conflicting or redundant entries.
A security level and password are assigned to each defined staff member.
User security levels are assigned at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function.
The GUI has analyzed the data before storing it in the database.
The system administrator is notified of any conflicting or redundant entries.
